description: Normalize sloppy model-generated Markdown to one house style, leaving code untouched — Rewrites Markdown from a language model into a consistent style and reports each edit by line: restores the space in '##Title', converts '*', '+' and '•' bullets to your chosen marker, strips trailing whitespace (keeping two-space hard breaks), collapses runs of blank lines, puts blank lines around headings and fenced blocks, closes a fence left open at the end, and ends the file with one newline.

blankLinesAroundBlocks.description: Insert a blank line around headings and top-level fenced blocks. Default true.

closeUnclosedFence.description: Append the closing fence when the document ends inside one. Default true.

collapseBlankLines.description: Collapse runs of blank lines and drop leading and trailing blanks. Default true.

finalNewline.description: End with exactly one newline. Default true.

fixHeadingSpace.description: Restore the space in '##Title'. A lowercase '#tag' at level 1 is treated as a hashtag and left alone. Default true.

stripTrailingWhitespace.description: Default true; a two-space hard break before more paragraph text is kept.

name: markdown-syntax-shaper
